description: This Swift source file defines the DiagnosticsFileLog actor responsible for logging diagnostic events into a JSON Lines file, with support for log rotation, directory management, and enabling/disabling via user preferences.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: An actor responsible for logging diagnostic records to a JSONL file with support for log rotation, directory creation, and conditional enabling based on user defaults.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether logging is enabled based on user preferences.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL to the current log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a diagnostic event with specified category, event, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all log files and backups.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a record to the log file, handling directory creation and rotation.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a single record to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Rotates log files if the current size exceeds the maximum threshold.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Constructs URL for rotated log files based on index.
